title: As parent know reading logs and "20 minutes a day" often backfire, maybe we switch it up encourage parents to "get caught" reading 60 minutes a week.
summary: As parent know reading logs and "20 minutes a day" often backfire, maybe we switch it up encourage parents to "get caught" reading 60 minutes a week. As a teacher I know SSR was also just a cat and mouse game of avoidance strategies and management
